tools.name: Meta Llama 4 Behemoth
tools.description: Llama 4 Behemoth is Meta’s ultimate “teacher” model within the Llama 4 series, currently in preview and training. Featuring an enormous 2 trillion total parameters with 288 billion active in a Mixture-of-Experts architecture (16 experts), it's designed to push the limits of multimodal reasoning, STEM, and long-context tasks.
bullets: Massive Scale: 2 trillion parameters—one of the largest MoEbased language models ever built.
STEM Benchmark Leader: Internal performance shows ~95% on MATH500, ~82% GPQA Diamond, ~85.8% multilingual MMLU—surpassing existing flagship models.

tools.name: Meta Llama 4 Maverick
tools.description: Llama 4 Maverick is Meta’s powerful mid-sized model in the Llama 4 series, released April 5, 2025. Built with a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture featuring 17 B active parameters (out of 400 B total) and 128 experts, it supports a 1 million-token context window and native multimodality for text and image inputs.
bullets: Native Multimodality: Processes text and images jointly using earlyfusion training.
UltraLong Context: 1 milliontoken window supports massive documents and complex workflows.

tools.name: Meta Llama 4 Scout
tools.description: Llama 4 Scout is Meta’s compact and high-performance entry in the Llama 4 family, released April 5, 2025. Built on a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture with 17B active parameters (109B total) and a staggering 10‑million-token context window, it delivers top-tier speed and long-context reasoning while fitting on a single Nvidia H100 GPU.
bullets: Unmatched Context Capacity: 10 million tokensfar exceed any other model's capability.
MoE Efficiency: 16 experts activate per token, balancing scalability and compute from MoE design.

tools.name: Meta Llama 4
tools.description: Meta Llama 4 is the latest generation of Meta’s large language model series. It features a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture, making it both highly efficient and powerful. Llama 4 is natively multimodal—supporting text and image inputs—and offers three key variants: Scout (17B active parameters, 10 M token context), Maverick (17B active, 1 M token context), and Behemoth (288B active, 2 T total parameters; still in development).
bullets: MixtureofExperts Efficiency: Only relevant expert subnetworks are activated, enabling high performance with fewer resources.
Native Multimodality: Joint training on text, images, and video enables coherent understanding across media types.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3
tools.description: Meta Llama 3 is Meta’s third-generation open-weight large language model family, released in April 2024 and enhanced in July 2024 with the 3.1 update. It spans three sizes—8B, 70B, and 405B parameters—each offering a 128K‑token context window.
bullets: Huge Context Window: 128K tokens across models—handled via grouped query attention and token masking.
MultiSize OpenWeight: 8B and 70B are opensource and accessible; 405B offers frontierlevel performance in research settings.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3.1
tools.description: Llama 3.1 is Meta’s most advanced open-source Llama 3 model, released on July 23, 2024. It comes in three sizes—8B, 70B, and 405B parameters—with an expanded 128K-token context window and improved multilingual and multimodal capabilities.
bullets: Expanded Context: 128Ktoken windowoffers ultralong input support versus typical 8K contexts.
Multimodal & Multilingual: Adds limited image understanding and strong multilingual abilities.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3.2
tools.description: Llama 3.2 is Meta’s multimodal and lightweight update to its Llama 3 line, released on September 25, 2024. The family includes 1B and 3B text-only models optimized for edge devices, as well as 11B and 90B Vision models capable of image understanding.
bullets: EdgeReady Text Models: 1B/3B run locally with low latency and minimal resource use.
First Open Multimodal: 11B/90B Vision models rival closedsource systems in chart and diagram understanding.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3.3
tools.description: Llama 3.3 is Meta’s instruction-tuned, text-only large language model released on December 6, 2024, available in a 70B-parameter size.
bullets: EdgeReady Text Models: 1B/3B run locally with low latency and minimal resource use.
First Open Multimodal: 11B/90B Vision models rival closedsource systems in chart and diagram understanding.

tools.name: Meta Llama 3.2 Vision
tools.description: Llama 3.2 Vision is Meta’s first open-source multimodal Llama model series, released on September 25, 2024. Available in 11 B and 90 B parameter sizes, it merges advanced image understanding with a massive 128 K‑token text context.
bullets: Vision Excellence: Achieves toptier scores—DocVQA ~70.7% and AI2 Diagram ~75.3% (11B) or ~90.1% & ~92.3% (90B).
Visual Math & Charts: ChartQA ~85.5% and MathVista ~57.3% with chainofthought reasoning.

tools.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill
tools.description: DeepSeek R1 Distill refers to a family of dense, smaller models distilled from DeepSeek’s flagship DeepSeek R1 reasoning model. Released early 2025, these models come in sizes ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters (e.g., DeepSeek‑R1‑Distill‑Qwen‑32B) and retain powerful reasoning and chain-of-thought abilities in a more efficient architecture. Benchmarks show distilled variants outperform models like OpenAI’s o1‑mini, while remaining open‑source under MIT license.

tools.name: lumalabs
tools.description: Luma Photon is a next-generation AI-powered image generation model designed for ultra-high-quality, cost-efficient visual creation. Built on a groundbreaking new architecture, Photon delivers ten-times higher cost efficiency while eliminating the traditional “AI look.” It is tailored for designers, filmmakers, architects, and creative professionals who need unparalleled control, realism, and personalization in their generated visuals.

tools.name: Bahama
tools.description: Bahama.ai is an innovative AI platform that empowers businesses to create and deploy personalized AI assistants. These tailored AI agents seamlessly integrate with internal data sources and third-party applications (like CRMs and project management systems) to streamline and automate various workflows across departments such as customer service, sales, and finance. The platform focuses on providing quick access to relevant data and actionable insights to enhance operational efficiency and informed decision-making.

tools.name: Odia Gen AI
tools.description: OdiaGenAI is a collaborative open-source initiative launched in 2023 to develop generative AI and LLM technologies tailored for Odia—a low-resource Indic language—and other regional languages. Led by Odia technologists and hosted under Odisha AI, it focuses on building pretrained, fine-tuned, and instruction-following models, datasets, and tools to empower areas like education, governance, agriculture, tourism, health, and industry.

tools.name: Mistral Magistral
tools.description: Magistral is Mistral AI’s first dedicated reasoning model, released on June 10, 2025, available in two versions: open-source 24 B Magistral Small and enterprise-grade Magistral Medium. It’s built to provide transparent, multilingual, domain-specific chain-of-thought reasoning, excelling in step-by-step logic tasks like math, finance, legal, and engineering.

tools.name: Mistral Ministral 3B
tools.description: Ministral refers to Mistral AI’s new “Les Ministraux” series—comprising Ministral 3B and Ministral 8B—launched in October 2024. These are ultra-efficient, open-weight LLMs optimized for on-device and edge computing, with a massive 128 K‑token context window. They offer strong reasoning, knowledge, multilingual support, and function-calling capabilities, outperforming previous models in the sub‑10B parameter class

tools.name: Mistral Saba
tools.description: Mistral Saba is a 24 billion‑parameter regional language model launched by Mistral AI on February 17, 2025. Designed for native fluency in Arabic and South Asian languages (like Tamil, Malayalam, and Urdu), it delivers culturally-aware responses on single‑GPU systems—faster and more precise than much larger general models.

tools.name: Mistral Small 3.1
tools.description: Mistral Small 3.1 is the March 17, 2025 update to Mistral AI's open-source 24B-parameter small model. It offers instruction-following, multimodal vision understanding, and an expanded 128K-token context window, delivering performance on par with or better than GPT‑4o Mini, Gemma 3, and Claude 3.5 Haiku—all while maintaining fast inference speeds (~150 tokens/sec) and running on devices like an RTX 4090 or a 32 GB Mac.

tools.name: LangChain AI
tools.description: LangChain AI Local Deep Researcher is an autonomous, fully local web research assistant designed to conduct in-depth research on user-provided topics. It leverages local Large Language Models (LLMs) hosted by Ollama or LM Studio to iteratively generate search queries, summarize findings from web sources, and refine its understanding by identifying and addressing knowledge gaps. The final output is a comprehensive markdown report with citations to all sources.

tools.name: Qwen Chat
tools.description: Qwen Chat is Alibaba Cloud’s conversational AI assistant built on the Qwen series (e.g., Qwen‑7B‑Chat, Qwen1.5‑7B‑Chat, Qwen‑VL, Qwen‑Audio, and Qwen2.5‑Omni). It supports text, vision, audio, and video understanding, plus image and document processing, web search integration, and image generation—all through a unified chat interface.
